title: CurriculumV1 Native Repair: sparse native plans stop falling back

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.15 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: Deep proof remains release-branch or manual pre-release proof. This patch uses the local 40-sample gold audit as broad compiler regression proof.

liveProvider.note: This release does not claim a fresh live EduTool.dev provider generation; live ZIP/log audits remain the discovery loop for future defects.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor review or approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: CourseIR v1 now validates and repairs constraints, prerequisite links, source ledger gaps, lesson concepts, and under-assessed courses before graph compilation.
Recoverable sparse native assembly repairs through CurriculumV1 and returns a CourseIR-backed graph instead of immediately falling back to prose.
Package manifests now include slim CourseIR and native-repair proof fields so downloaded ZIPs can disclose repaired curriculum graphs.
The research-methods genome shard adds grounded introductory concepts and loader coverage so relevant courses can link deterministic kernels.
The release uses broad local proof because it changes compiler behavior: focused tests, full unit suite, constitution audit, build, bundle check, and 40 gold samples.

carryForward.next: Route providers to dense CourseIR in one call when model limits make it safe, then compile all artifacts from the validated IR instead of prose.
Add preservation tests for optional readings and resources through CurriculumV1 repair before broadening repaired native cases.
